dimensions.description: Measures factual accuracy and whether the answer avoids false loan eligibility claims.

dimensions.description: Measures whether the answer covers all important parts of the question.

evaluation_rules: Each dimension must receive an integer score from 0 to 5.
All dimension weights must sum to 1.0.
Do not invent lender-specific eligibility policies.
Mention when additional information is required.
